protocol.name: Angle-domain sparse referenced-magnitude Rician EM
protocol.objective: sigma2/2 * sum(Rician NLL) + lambda * sum(abs(X)); G=A X
protocol.selection: Per observed normalized variance and reference only, mean 21/9 heldout NLL balanced across all three path regimes; no true G or L input to selection. Ties choose lower iterations then smaller factor.
protocol.context_masks: Random fixed masks, split seed 2026101801 + SNR integer.
protocol.inference: Refit selected controls on all 30 pilots.
protocol.independent_cells: Common generator uses local trial offsets 0 for random paths, 100000 for L2, 200000 for L4. RNG additionally keys SNR/RSR; all methods receive identical observations.
protocol.comparison: Three separately trained learned models (reported separately and mean scores, no ensemble), EM100, existing frozen offline OptShrink.
limitations: finite generalized EM inner/outer budgets; global optimum not guaranteed

frozen_inputs.generator_policy: Independent operating point RNG keys include SNR and RSR; path-regime trial offsets prevent overlap; high-SNR study may explicitly couple worlds by rescaling a fixed anchor noise realization.
